title: Encounter Record (v0)
description: The authoritative scientific record of one executed match, written to the SFE ledger. Generalizes the World-0 failure-coordinate discipline to multi-player encounters: outcomes are COORDINATE VECTORS, never booleans; an observed loss is not a verdict; hidden authoritative world state (injected faults, regime switches, true hidden state) is recorded HERE for later scientific audit while remaining invisible to players. History is immutable: later reinterpretation (qualification, bump candidacy, PEW metabolization) never alters this record.

host_id.description: which machine executed it. Recorded for replay-audit sampling; NEVER a factor in any scientific statistic.

ledger_seq.description: engine event sequence of this record; the chronological anchor

trace_hash.description: hash of the full canonical trace (observations, actions, transitions, seed-stream draws), stored as a content-addressed artifact. Cross-host replay compares THIS. Divergence tolerance is ZERO.

trace_artifact.description: content address of the full trace

termination.description: INFRASTRUCTURE_ABORT records exist for audit but are excluded from every landscape statistic and every qualification decision

per_slot.description: one entry per player slot; the player-side coordinate vector

checkpoint_out.description: content address of learned state after the encounter, if the player persists state. Referenceable by later manifests ONLY after this record is qualified.

outcome_vector.description: the world's raw outcome channels for this slot -- resources held, absorbing flags, structural counters. RAW AND WORLD-DEFINED. No aggregate score field exists anywhere in this schema; scoring conventions live in versioned analysis code, never in the record.

resource_state.description: separates 'could not' from 'could not afford'; required for resource-normalized landscape statistics

abstention_ticks.description: ticks with no action emitted. First-class: economic pressure selects for inaction, and an uninstrumented non-attempt would deform the landscape invisibly.

behavior_digest.description: hash-sketch of the action stream (fixed scheme, versioned); supports behavioral-distance statistics without reading full traces

world_events.description: HIDDEN AUTHORITATIVE WORLD STATE record: what the world actually did, whether or not any player could observe it. This is what makes 'an observed loss is not necessarily player failure' analyzable: self failure vs world fault vs observation corruption vs chance are distinguishable HERE and only here. Never exposed to players; outcomes reach players as observations, not verdicts.

landscape_cell.description: discretized (world-region x outcome-class) cell id, computed by a FROZEN, versioned cell function. The occupancy of these cells across millions of encounters IS the failure landscape the bump detector watches. The cell function is part of the instrument: changing it is a new instrument version, and cross-version comparison is forbidden.

qualification.description: APPENDED by the qualification pass, never edited: the original execution fields above are immutable.

replay_host_id.description: when replay-audited, on which OTHER host

$comment: FOSSIL RULES: (a) no record is deleted, downsampled, or compacted -- a zero-outcome encounter is landscape, not noise; (b) no aggregate score, ranking, or 'interestingness' field may be added to this schema -- those are analysis products bound to analysis-code versions; (c) worker/host telemetry lives elsewhere; the only host field here is host_id for replay audit; (d) hidden world_events are for the scientist and the crucible -- any path that leaks them to players is a semantic-quarantine breach (kill criterion).
